notes.title: Ending in darkness
notes.body: Psalm 88 closes without a conventional turn to praise. Scripture preserves unresolved despair. This must not be used to shame depression, demand forced optimism, or romanticize self-harm.

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: This psalm preserves profound despair without blaming the sufferer. It must not romanticize self-harm or be used to shame depression or require forced optimism.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit.
